ITEM 1 | Small whole red cherry tomatoes, glossy bright red with smooth skin, about 2.5-3 cm diameter, roughly 12-14 pieces scattered across the left and center of the bowl, firm and juicy-looking, not cut | 190
ITEM 2 | Shredded orange carrot, thin matchstick strands about 0.3 cm wide and 4-6 cm long, bright orange with slight sheen, moist, loosely piled across the left-center and lower area of the bowl | 60
ITEM 3 | Green bell pepper, cut into flat thick strips about 0.8-1 cm wide and 5-7 cm long, matte bright green with pale inner edges, firm and crisp-looking, scattered across the right and lower portion | 75
ITEM 4 | Red bell pepper, cut into strips about 1 cm wide and 4-6 cm long, glossy red with slightly wrinkled skin, a few pieces mixed among the tomatoes and green strips in the upper center and right | 25
ITEM 5 | Cucumber or zucchini-like pale green strips, sliced lengthwise about 0.6 cm wide and 5-6 cm long, light green with pale flesh edges, lying flat in a cluster across the center-left of the bowl | 25
